타자 연습 대회:
text = input()
n = int(input())
L = len(text)
name = []
good = []
len_ = []
time = []
for _ in range(n):
    a, s, t = input().split()
    wrong = abs(L - len(s))
    for i in range(min(L, len(s))):
        if text[i] != s[i]:
            wrong += 1
    g = L - wrong
    if g < 0:
        g = 0
    name.append(a)
    good.append(g)
    len_.append(len(s))
    time.append(int(t))
for i in range(n - 1):
    for j in range(n - 1 - i):
        swap = False
        if good[j] < good[j + 1]:
            swap = True
        elif good[j] == good[j + 1] and len_[j] * time[j + 1] < len_[j + 1] * time[j]:
            swap = True
        if swap:
            name[j], name[j + 1] = name[j + 1], name[j]
            good[j], good[j + 1] = good[j + 1], good[j]
            len_[j], len_[j + 1] = len_[j + 1], len_[j]
            time[j], time[j + 1] = time[j + 1], time[j]
for i in range(n):
    print(f"{i + 1} {name[i]} {good[i] * 100 // L}% {len_[i] * 60 // time[i]}타")
